Name: Aesthetic Ores v2
Author: NerdyKirby2
Description:
I love the recolors of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9211]XxHarvzBackxX's Aesthetic Ores[/url] but ran into an issue where 1.6 tools were missing! This mod fixes that issue, and updates the rock crab monsters to use the reskinned ores as well! This is also SVE compatible so SVE rock crabs will also be reskinned.

Don't want the rock crabs to be little tricksters? Did you like being able to tell what's a crab and what's an ore rock? No worries - you can configure the mod to ignore the rock crab updates! Enjoy speeding through the Skull Caverns with one less thing to worry about.

Future Updates to Include:
- Reskinning the iridium meteorite
- Possibly adjusting palettes a bit

I have not tested this on a game without SVE but it should work without a problem. Please let me know if you run into any issues.
